mapper.select: SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT NOTIF_ID , MBR_CD , NOTIF_TITLE , NOTIF_MSG , NOTIF_DT , NOTIF_TYPE_CD , NOTIF_TYPE_GROUP_CD , NOTIF_REF_URL , NOTIF_READ_YN , NOTIF_DEL_YN FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE MBR_CD = 'M2507000146' AND NOTIF_READ_YN ='N' AND NOTIF_DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY NOTIF_DT DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM BETWEEN 1 AND 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.*, ROWNUM RNUM FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NOTIF_ID , MBR_CD , NOTIF_TITLE , NOTIF_MSG , NOTIF_DT , NOTIF_TYPE_CD , NOTIF_TYPE_GROUP_CD , NOTIF_REF_URL , NOTIF_READ_YN , NOTIF_DEL_YN FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE MBR_CD = #{username} AND NOTIF_DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY NOTIF_DT DESC ) A
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastRecordIndex} ) WHERE RNUM >= #{firstRecordIndex}
